summary: This Form 6-K reports the entry into a note purchase agreement by IM Cannabis Corp., a foreign private issuer, for a convertible note and warrant offering of $225,000. The filing describes standard financing terms: 8% interest, conversion at a variable price with a floor, and a five-year warrant. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The offering is a routine capital raise for general corporate purposes, akin to an ordinary shelf takedown. No deal terms are applicable.
